findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 29 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 20 questions numbered 1-20; by section: u-introduction-em-radiation 3, 29.1 2, 29.2 1, 29.3 1, 29.4 3, 29.5 4, 29.6 6.

Theory parts cover electromagnetic radiation and Planck's theory, IHD and its importance, absorption spectra, spectroscopy and identification of elements, the UV-Vis principle, conjugation and λmax, the IR principle, IR spectra of functional groups and their use, mass spectrometry and the molecular ion, fragmentation, and the M+1 and M+2 peaks. Numericals (c = λν and E = hν / hcν̄, IHD, absorbance, relative atomic mass, number of carbon atoms from M+1, formula from M⁺ and isotope peaks) use new values recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed (n = non-bonding, 1:2:1 for two Br); E = hν, 290 nm and cm⁻¹ are used as standard forms.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
